description: Runs every check of create_vm and prices it, without creating anything: would_succeed, hourly rate, monthly price, credit required. Call it before create_vm. Scope: vms.create.

billing.description: Hourly draws on prepaid credit; monthly raises an invoice. Fixed for the life of the machine.

hostname.description: Letters, digits, dots and hyphens; no leading, trailing or doubled separator.

image.description: Image slug from list_images, e.g. debian-13.

ipv4.description: false orders an IPv6-only machine, cheaper; outbound IPv4 goes through NAT64.

options.description: Paid options declared by the plan, by name.

plan.description: Plan slug from list_plans, e.g. nano.

private_only.description: No public address at all; needs vpc. Reachable only from the private network, Internet through its gateway. Priced like ipv4: false.

region.description: Region slug from list_regions, e.g. montreal.

ssh_keys.description: Fingerprints or ids of SSH keys already on the account (see list_ssh_keys).

vpc.description: Private network id (list_vpcs) to connect the machine to, in the same region.

name: estimate_vm
title: Estimate an order
